items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Even Gene's wife, she said... I told them, 'Well, I'll have a book.' She says, 'You must be kidding.'

ctx.x: people! But I made it and everything.
Even Gene's wife, she said... I told them, 'Well, I'll have a book.' She says, 'You must be kidding.' I said, 'No, I ain't kidding.' Hell, I turned out to be the big thing for the band, you know.

I had one little incident there. We was playing 'Rockin' Chair'... Benny Carter had worked with them over at Meadowbrook, had made an arrangement on 'Rockin' Chair.' You know, Benny didn't know until he talked to me last year that he didn't make that arrangement for me? He thought that he had made that arrangement for me, and he made it for himself! But the way I did...my doing it and him doing it was two different things, you know.
